title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic! — Episode3 Colorfully Hidden Truth

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Event Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Line: Highlands

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! This is awesome!
We're not even at the top and you can see all those mountains way over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, wait. I should take some pictures too. They could come in handy when I draw later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's this? Ena's not immediately going for some selfies? Interesting...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*... It's not like that's the only thing I ever think about, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, I'm getting pretty hungry. Why don't we have lunch here and enjoy the view? I made enough food for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, me too! I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everything Airi makes is so good too. I'm excited to see what she brought today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This looks amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I made most of it last night and tried to include something that everyone likes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it looks delicious! Let's dig in♪
Oh, perfect! French fries!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena told me that you like them a lot, Mizuki. I made them a little well-done to keep them from getting too soggy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, but this one tastes like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Fried tofu skins. You requested them, Shizuku, so I decided to make some. I wrapped them around some pieces of chicken.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Nom*...
Oh, it's delicious...! You're such a good cook, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I made some cheesecake for you, Ena. This one has a lemony zest to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yay! I still can't help but think your cheesecake is store bought, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mmm! Everything's so good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're awesome, Airi! You go to school while being an idol and you make amazing food?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, this is nothing.
As for being an idol, we support each member as a team, and everyone's been a huge help so far.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that. Also, what was your group called again? MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. We mainly make videos and do livestreams.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I saw one of your streams the other day. You guys were doing dance practice and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You did?! Thank you so much!
But we had to try so many times to get it right. I doubt it was very interesting from your point of view...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, you kept messing up in the beginning, but it was also pretty heartwarming in the end...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter how many times you failed, Shizuku, you kept trying and got it perfect in the end, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After I saw you do that, I felt like trying a little harder myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ena, I don't know what to say...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good for you, Shizuku!
I'm sure Ena's not alone either.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right!
Hehe. I feel like I've taken a step towards becoming an idol who delivers hope...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An idol who delivers hope, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I just thought that's pretty incredible is all. I wouldn't even know where to start if I decided to try giving someone hope...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you two make songs together, right? Isn't that another way to do just that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You think so?
It'd be nice if that were true...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, no! It's nothing! Anyways, Airi, can I have some more of those french fries?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it. I'm glad you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Was Mizuki about to just...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for the food!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That was so good, Airi! I'm stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're very welcome.
You guys didn't leave even a single crumb, so it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, we should probably get going soon...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? There's quite a few people gathered over there. I wonder what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Register here for the Green Adventure! Please make sure to fill out the necessary forms if you wish to participate!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The Green Adventure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it's the game where you guess the names of plants and rivers while you're hiking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? How did you know that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One of the guides that I saw after we got off the bus told me. Anyone can join as long as they register for it. Wanna give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, me! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure? There could be a bunch of bugs over that way, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then how about Mizuki and Airi go join them, while Ena and I have a look around here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, but Mizuki's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi may just be able to get something out of Mizuki. How about we leave her to it just for now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna go for a perfect score! Ready, Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's hurry and get registered, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's so green and beautiful...!
Almost like an open-world RPG!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That sounds like exactly something you'd say, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, that should be enough stretching for now. How about we start with a little jog?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's even a trail running course over there too. Let's go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? This is all we're doing?
It seems too normal, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you'll need to wear this while you run...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What is this, chainmail?!
It's so heavy...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a weighted jacket, but I also added quite a few features to make sure it's safe to use. Unfortunately, it ended up weighing more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll also need to put on these knee braces, as well as this helmet. It should fit right over your cap...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what?! All of these...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, perfect!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It feels so clunky... You turned me into a robot, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, let's start running!
Try your best, Nene!
I'll be right there with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hnng...! It's... So... Heavy...!
